subject: Tri-region facilitator split — co-sell demo scheduling with CloudHarbor
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: (planning) tri-region co-sell demo — split facilitator idea

Team — quick planning note for the CloudHarbor co-sell demo next week. They want a single 90-minute session that must serve three audiences (US product owners, EU SI leads, APAC prospects). Customer preference: APAC mornings (their side), EU late morning, US afternoon PST.

Ask: I propose we split facilitator responsibilities across the session so we can: 1) hand off live demos without a hard break, 2) record segments per region, and 3) publish a marketplace recording per region.

Proposed facilitator assignments (draft):
- APAC segment (00:00–00:30): Vanessa (lead facilitator) — focus on APAC integration + on-prem patterns
- EU segment (00:30–01:10): Karthik (tech deep-dive) — SI-focused runbook + security notes
- US wrap and Q&A (01:10–01:30): Kimberly — product positioning + pricing funnel

Can you each confirm availability and whether you need a backup? I attached the draft runbook and CloudHarbor SOW so we can call out required artifacts. If this split looks good I'll propose specific time windows to Elena and Matt and ask for attendee lists (we may need to split the calendar invite into three region-tagged blocks to make recordings clean).

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Partner GTM Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T10:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: (planning) tri-region co-sell demo — split facilitator idea

Sofia — looks good. I can take APAC morning slot, and I can be on backup for EU if needed. A couple of operational asks:
- Can we confirm who will own the recording ownership in the marketplace listing? (we need the right contact so the recording gets uploaded to their partner page)
- For the APAC segment I want 10 extra minutes to show a live connector failover test — that will be helpful for the SI audience. If we add that, we should trim US Q&A to 12 minutes.

I reviewed the runbook: the pre-demo checklist needs an explicit step for customer VPN access. I'll add that as step 2.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Partner Solutions Director, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Matt Li <matt.li@cloudharbor.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T14:22:00+01:00
Subject: Redwood × CloudHarbor — proposed tri-region session split (please confirm)

Elena / Matt — thanks again for coordinating. To make the session useful for regional SI and prospect audiences, Redwood proposes running one continuous 90-minute demo with region-focused facilitator handoffs. Outline below (local times shown as examples):

Session outline (90 mins total) — draft
- 00:00–00:32 APAC-focused run (APAC morning): Vanessa — live connector + HA failover test
- 00:32–01:08 EU SI deep-dive: Karthik — security, runbook integration, quantization/ops notes
- 01:08–01:30 US market: Kimberly — product positioning + pricing + live Q&A

Operational asks from CloudHarbor: attendee lists per region, confirmation of APAC morning preference (we can run 7:00–8:30 SGT if that works), and any compliance artifacts needed for the SI deep-dive (we already attached the SOW and runbook draft).

Attachments: CloudHarbor_Demo_SOW.pdf (summary), redwood_runbook_v1.md (draft)

Please confirm by EOD so we can lock facilitator backups and issue calendar invites. If APAC attendees need a later window, suggest two options and we'll adapt.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Partner GTM Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena@cloudharbor.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Li <matt.li@cloudharbor.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T02:11:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Redwood × CloudHarbor — proposed tri-region session split (please confirm)

Sofia — thanks for the clear plan. We can do the split; a few notes from our side: 
- APAC attendee availability: Japan/SEA SIs asked for a 08:00–09:30 JST window (so 07:00–08:30 SGT you proposed is ok if we nudge to 08:00 SGT start). Can you do APAC 08:00–08:32 SGT?
- EU SI deep-dive: our lead architect will join but requests that the security slides be available 24 hours pre-demo. Can you confirm we'll share the runbook slides by 2028-04-18 18:00 UTC?
- Recording: we are fine with a continuous recording but we'd prefer region-tagged segments for the marketplace upload. We will upload to our partner portal and tag by region.

Attaching the calendar ICS from our side (CloudHarbor_demo_APAC.ics) — will add to the invite once time is finalized.

Elena
Elena Torres | Head of Alliances, CloudHarbor
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T11:36:00-04:00
Subject: Final: CloudHarbor tri-region demo — confirmed times and runbook actions

All — final thumbs-up from CloudHarbor. Summary and action items: 
- Final times (continuous session, region local starts):
   * APAC segment: 08:00–08:32 SGT (Vanessa lead; Vanessa backup: Karthik)
   * EU segment: 08:32–09:08 BST (Karthik lead)
   * US wrap/Q&A: 04:08–04:30 PST (Kimberly lead)
- Runbook deliverables: share slides + redwood_runbook_v1.md by 2028-04-18T18:00:00Z (Karthik to own security slides + Vanessa to confirm VPN checklist update)
- Recording & marketplace: Elena will upload region-tagged segments; Kimberly + Sofia will be recording owners in the HubSpot record (HS-11234) so we can track post-demo assets and credits.
- Attachments added to the thread: CloudHarbor_Demo_SOW.pdf, redwood_runbook_v1.md; CloudHarbor also supplied CloudHarbor_demo_APAC.ics (see SCC note).

Please confirm when you have uploaded your slides to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-runbook-CH-DH1973 — I'll lock calendar invites after that.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Partner GTM Lead, Redwood Inference
